screen_mappings.design_notes: Prioritize day type and remaining calories visibility
Treat weight as guaranteed editable field
Client does not have direct pending inbox API
Keep upsert form resilient to partial data
Backend notification center not yet modeled

design_constraints: Client self-context ownership is enforced on most trainee routes via requireOwnership.
No delete endpoints for meal/workout/weight logs; use edit/correction UX.
Clients cannot mutate menus/programs; those are coach-managed.
Day type is foundational for calorie/menu logic and can block assistant actions.
Conversation state persists with TTL in redis/memory for multi-step assistant flows.
Assistant tool failures and uncertainty can force escalation to coach reply.
Workout exercise patch docs and implementation diverge (docs imply full update; controller parses weight only).
Weight update docs and implementation diverge (controller parses create DTO).
Client menu list contract currently diverges from runtime payload shape (summary vs full nested).
Generated SDK date types for some metrics fields are loose objects due z.date schema generation.
Meal history service query is currently date-windowed (~30 days).
Public client messaging write contract is missing.
Client conversation-list contract is missing (only coach list exists).
Inbox pending logic and ai-triage handledAt behavior appear inconsistent and should be aligned before launch.
Day-boundary calculations rely on server timezone unless normalized.
